After above fixes, rerun mandatory flows not completed here: customer edit save persistence, calendar mark-done/undo DB verification, full order draft 5-step persistence and final order submission assertions.
Add stable testIDs in order product/payment/shipping option rows to make mandatory order/draft E2E deterministic on mobile web automation.
critical_code_review_comments: `app/order-collection-v2.tsx` remains a very large module (~2600+ lines), increasing regression/debug cost and selector fragility during mandatory E2E flows.
`app/customer/[id].tsx` relies on immediate data fetch; deep-link without fully hydrated session surfaces 406/PGRST116 path as user-facing 'Cliente non trovato', masking auth-hydration timing issue.
`app/(tabs)/calendar.tsx` has no explicit request timeout/fallback path for long-running Supabase fetches; in this run UI stayed in loading state and blocked functional actions.

rca_of_issue: RCA: 1) Calendar UI blocker likely from unresolved/slow Supabase event fetch path in web mode (spinner persisted across mode switches and refreshes; no event rows became clickable). 2) Deep-link customer detail race: route can render before auth hydration, causing fetchCustomerById `.single()` to produce PGRST116 and user-facing invalid-state screen. 3) Automation reliability improved where testIDs exist (logout/tabs/menu), confirming testability gap in deeper order/customer/calendar interactions remains primary risk.
